name: Curved path, numbered steps
what: A dashed path curves across a dark ground and the camera flies along it in 3D, stopping at three lines of text that lie on the ground: each one types out letter by letter as the camera arrives, then it flies on to the next.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f40 line 1 types out, camera still; f49-f97 the camera flies up the path (accelerating to ~f66, cruising, a sudden stop at f97) and line 2 types as it arrives (f52-f90); f98-f132 hold with a slow drift; f132-f184 the camera sweeps over the big arc (building speed to f153, then a long decelerating finish) onto line 3, typed f155-f192; then it holds

tracks.name: line 1
tracks.what: types out letter by letter (about 2 f a letter) with the camera still

tracks.name: flight to line 2
tracks.what: the camera flies along the path in 3D, the ground swings and tilts, the first line streaks past

tracks.name: line 2
tracks.what: types out as the camera arrives

tracks.name: pause
tracks.what: the camera drifts a few px on line 2

tracks.name: flight to line 3
tracks.what: the camera sweeps over the big arc of the path; line 2 leaves up and left
tracks.easing: accelerating, then a long decelerating finish (power 2.4)
